        The college offers running at the level of 4th and Sixth Semester

can choose :                                                             .




   (i)     Any one subject from the above as DSC (Discipline

   (ii)    From DSM (Discipline Specific Minor) students shall take
           two subjects related to his/her discipline. Each such
           subject should of 50% of total credit allotted to this
           course. And the total credit shall be of 26.
   (iii)   IDC (Interdisciplinary Courses) which have 03 baskets
           viz; Social Sciences(SS), Humanities(HN), Natural
           Sciences(NS). Students may opt for any one from those
           03 baskets in each of I,II and III Semester. IDC courses
           opted shall remain same for all three semesters. Semester
           wise change of IDC is not allowed.
